requirements.quote:
This value is computed by hashing the concatenation
of each included handshake message, including the handshake message
header carrying the handshake message type and length fields, but not
including record layer headers.
requirements.required_behavior: hash the concatenation of included handshake messages in transcript order
requirements.forbidden_behavior: hash messages separately without preserving their transcript concatenation
requirements.why_checkable: A known sequence of encoded messages yields a reproducible hash input.

requirements.quote:

of each included handshake message, including the handshake message
header carrying the handshake message type and length fields, but not

requirements.condition: computing a TLS transcript hash from handshake records
requirements.required_behavior: exclude record-layer headers from the hash input
requirements.forbidden_behavior: include record-layer headers in the transcript hash
requirements.why_checkable: Captured record bytes can distinguish the record header from the encoded handshake message.

requirements.quote:
As an exception to this general rule, when the server responds to a
ClientHello with a HelloRetryRequest, the value of ClientHello1 is
replaced with a special synthetic handshake message of handshake type
"message_hash" containing Hash(ClientHello1).
requirements.condition: the server responds to ClientHello1 with HelloRetryRequest
requirements.required_behavior: replace ClientHello1 in the transcript with a synthetic handshake message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: retain the encoded ClientHello1 directly in the post-HelloRetryRequest transcript
requirements.why_checkable: The transcript state after HelloRetryRequest can be recomputed from ClientHello1.

requirements.quote:
Hash(message_hash ||        /* Handshake type */
     00 00 Hash.length  ||  /* Handshake message length (bytes) */
     Hash(ClientHello1) ||  /* Hash of ClientHello1 */
     HelloRetryRequest  || ... || Mn)
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use ClientHello or another handshake type for the synthetic message
requirements.why_checkable: The first byte of the synthetic handshake encoding is directly inspectable.

requirements.quote:
Hash(message_hash ||        /* Handshake type */
     00 00 Hash.length  ||  /* Handshake message length (bytes) */
     Hash(ClientHello1) ||  /* Hash of ClientHello1 */
     HelloRetryRequest  || ... || Mn)
requirements.required_behavior: encode its three-byte handshake length as 00 00 Hash.length
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode a length different from the negotiated hash output length
requirements.why_checkable: The synthetic message length bytes have an exact expected encoding.

requirements.quote:
Hash(message_hash ||        /* Handshake type */
     00 00 Hash.length  ||  /* Handshake message length (bytes) */
     Hash(ClientHello1) ||  /* Hash of ClientHello1 */
     HelloRetryRequest  || ... || Mn)
requirements.required_behavior: use Hash(ClientHello1) as the synthetic message body
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use the raw ClientHello1 or a hash of different bytes as the body
requirements.why_checkable: The body can be compared with a direct hash of the first ClientHello encoding.

requirements.quote:
ClientHello, HelloRetryRequest, ClientHello, ServerHello,
EncryptedExtensions, server CertificateRequest, server Certificate,
server CertificateVerify, server Finished, EndOfEarlyData, client
Certificate, client CertificateVerify, client Finished.
requirements.required_behavior: preserve the defined order of ClientHello, optional retry sequence, server authentication messages, EndOfEarlyData, and client authentication messages
requirements.forbidden_behavior: reorder included handshake messages in the transcript
requirements.why_checkable: A trace supplies a concrete ordered list that can be compared with transcript updates.

requirements.quote:
Note,
however, that subsequent post-handshake authentications do not
include each other, just the messages through the end of the main
handshake.
requirements.condition: computing a transcript for a subsequent post-handshake authentication
requirements.forbidden_behavior: include messages from an earlier post-handshake authentication
requirements.why_checkable: Multiple post-handshake exchanges can test whether prior exchange bytes affect the signature.

requirements.quote:
Note,
however, that subsequent post-handshake authentications do not
include each other, just the messages through the end of the main
handshake.
requirements.condition: forming the base transcript for post-handshake authentication
requirements.required_behavior: include the handshake messages through the end of the main handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: truncate the base transcript before the main handshake ends
requirements.why_checkable: The saved main-handshake transcript hash can be compared with the post-handshake base state.
